nusmp.page.book_compass.needle_flick: Flicks one golden compass needle straight ahead; the first foe it touches takes a light hit.
nusmp.page.book_compass.bearing_step: Takes a bearing and steps up to 8 blocks forward along it, a short move without a hit.
nusmp.page.book_compass.magnet_draw: Draws the foe under your crosshair in towards you with a magnetic tug and hits it lightly on the way.
nusmp.page.book_compass.true_heading: The compass settles on true north: you run faster for ten seconds and your melee hits carry a little extra weight.
nusmp.page.book_compass.lodestone_snare: A lodestone needle pins one foe in place: heavy slowness for a few seconds and a small hit (shares the control cooldown).
nusmp.page.book_compass.cardinal_volley: Four homing needles, one for each cardinal point, each seeking a different foe.
nusmp.page.book_compass.declination_wave: A wave of bent magnetic force in front of you that hurts and shoves foes far off their line.
nusmp.page.book_compass.dead_reckoning: Plots a straight course and drives a long needle along it, hitting everything on the line.
nusmp.page.book_compass.safe_bearing: The compass points the way to safety: you and your allies nearby regain a part of their health.
nusmp.page.book_compass.magnetic_storm: A storm of scattered needles at the aim point for four seconds: foes inside are hit every half second and dragged slow.
nusmp.page.book_compass.meridian_lance: A huge needle along the meridian: a long, wide line that hits hard and shoves foes along it.
nusmp.page.book_compass.cardinal_burst: All four points of the compass fire at once in a ring around you, hurting and knocking back everything close.
nusmp.page.book_copy.borrowed_strike: A copied swing: a short narrow sweep in front of you that hurts and nudges foes back.
nusmp.page.book_copy.echo_step: You step 7 blocks forward and leave an echo of yourself behind; a plain move, no hit.
nusmp.page.book_copy.touch_and_learn: Touching foes close to you copies a little of their vigour: a small burst that hurts them and heals you slightly.
nusmp.page.book_copy.returned_blow: For six seconds you copy every blow aimed at you: attackers take a little of it back and your own hits are stronger.
nusmp.page.book_copy.delayed_echo: Hits one foe, then the copy of the strike lands again about a second later for a smaller hit.
nusmp.page.book_copy.mimic_fan: A fan of copied force in front of you; foes it touches are hurt and weakened for four seconds.
nusmp.page.book_copy.imitated_fetters: Copies the bindings of other mages and wraps one foe in them: heavy slowness and a small hit (shares the control cooldown).
nusmp.page.book_copy.copycat_pounce: You blink behind the foe you look at and strike it in the back as you pass.
nusmp.page.book_copy.hall_of_echoes: Echoes of every blow fill the aimed spot for four seconds: foes inside are hit every half second and slowed.
nusmp.page.book_copy.chorus_of_copies: A choir of your copies sings at the aimed spot and blasts everything round it away.
nusmp.page.book_copy.perfect_reproductio: The strongest copy: a huge burst around you that shoves foes away and strips one beneficial effect from each, copying it for the moment.
nusmp.page.book_dice.snake_eyes: Throws a pair of dice that burst in a small blast where they land and slow the foes they hit.
nusmp.page.book_dice.pip_toss: Three dice tumble out in a fan, each stinging the first foe it meets.
nusmp.page.book_dice.lucky_seven: The dice come up seven: ten seconds of speed and luck, and your blows hit a little harder.
nusmp.page.book_dice.dice_cup_shake: Shakes a cup of dice in front of you and spills them: a short cone that hurts and knocks foes back.
nusmp.page.book_dice.critical_roll: Rolls a d20 against the foe you look at: a natural 20 hits for half again as much, a natural 1 barely scratches, anything else scales with the roll.
nusmp.page.book_dice.double_or_nothing: Rolls two dice: seven or more and a burst round you hits hard, otherwise it is only a small hit.
nusmp.page.book_dice.bowling_roll: Rolls a heavy die along the ground in a line that hits everything on it and knocks foes aside.
nusmp.page.book_dice.snare_roll: Throws a d20 at one foe and pins it where it lands: heavy slowness for a few seconds (shares the control cooldown).
nusmp.page.book_dice.reroll: Throws the bad result away: clears up to four harmful effects from you and gives a few seconds of regeneration.
nusmp.page.book_dice.craps_table: A table of tumbling dice at the aimed spot for four seconds: foes inside are hit every half second and slowed.
nusmp.page.book_dice.rain_of_dice: Five homing dice rain out over your foes and knock them about.
nusmp.page.book_slash.rending_cut: A quick narrow cut of mana blades in front of you that rends whatever it meets.
nusmp.page.book_slash.cross_slash: Two crescents fly out one after the other, crossing in front of you like an X.
nusmp.page.book_slash.razor_flurry: A spinning flurry of short cuts all round you that hits every foe within arm's reach.
nusmp.page.book_slash.edge_guard: Blades along your forearms turn every blow aimed at you: for six seconds attackers are cut back and your own hits are stronger.
nusmp.page.book_slash.crescent_salvo: Five projected crescents fan out in front of you.
nusmp.page.book_slash.severing_line: One long straight cut that slices everything on a 14 block line.
nusmp.page.book_slash.blade_cyclone: A cyclone of blades round you that cuts nearby foes and lifts them off the ground.
nusmp.page.book_slash.hamstring_cut: A low slash that flies straight and cuts the legs of the foe it hits: heavy slowness for four seconds.
nusmp.page.book_slash.parrying_blades: For three seconds your blades cut arrows and magic bolts out of the air before they reach you (at most three per step).
nusmp.page.book_slash.final_slash: The last cut: a long, wide slash that severs everything on its line and throws foes aside.
nusmp.page.book_slash.reaper_field: Blades dance round you for three seconds, hitting every foe that comes close, every half second.
nusmp.page.book_gravity.gravity_jab: A short heavy jab in front of you: foes it hits are hurt and weighed down, slowed for two seconds.
nusmp.page.book_gravity.ground_slam: You bring your own weight down on the ground: a burst of crushing force that hurts and slows foes within reach.
nusmp.page.book_gravity.featherfall: Lets go of your own weight for ten seconds: no fall damage and a higher jump, and your blows stay a little heavier.
nusmp.page.book_gravity.pressure_lane: Presses a lane of heavy air along the ground in front of you: foes on it are hit and pinned down by slowness for three seconds.
nusmp.page.book_gravity.inward_pull: Draws every foe around the aimed point into a tight knot and hits them for half a blow.
nusmp.page.book_gravity.anchor_weight: Hangs an anchor of weight on the foe you look at: heavy slowness for a few seconds (shares the control cooldown).
nusmp.page.book_gravity.weightless_burst: Takes the weight from foes round you for a moment: they are hit and thrown up into the air.
nusmp.page.book_gravity.gravity_singular: A small black hole at the aimed point drags foes in for two seconds, then collapses and crushes everything it holds.
nusmp.page.book_gravity.falling_weight: Drops a huge weight on the aimed spot: foes under it are hit, shoved away and slowed for three seconds.
nusmp.page.book_game.health_potion: Drinks a potion and shares it: you and your allies close to you regain a part of their health.
nusmp.page.book_game.warp_tile: A warp tile under your feet throws you 8 blocks forward; a plain move, no hit.
nusmp.page.book_game.button_mash: Four quick d20 shots in a row, each stinging the first foe it meets.
nusmp.page.book_game.skip_turn: The foe you look at loses its turn: frozen in place for a few seconds (shares the control cooldown).
nusmp.page.book_game.fog_of_war: Covers the map round you in fog: foes close to you are hit and blinded for three seconds.
nusmp.page.book_game.combo_chain: A rush of hits as you move 9 blocks forward: everything on the way is struck.
nusmp.page.book_game.loot_drop: Foes close to you drop their loot in a burst: they are hurt and you regain a little health.
nusmp.page.book_game.boss_arena: Locks an arena round the aimed spot for five seconds: foes inside are hit every half second and slowed.
nusmp.page.book_game.random_encounter: A game board opens under the foes at the aimed spot and each rolls its own d20: low rolls take a heavy hit, high rolls nearly dodge it.
nusmp.page.book_spatial.archangel_shootd: Launches a sphere of spatial force that bursts where it lands and erases one beneficial effect from every foe it catches.
nusmp.page.book_spatial.rift_step: Steps through a rift 8 blocks ahead; a plain move, no hit.
nusmp.page.book_spatial.crevice_men: Opens a crack in space along a line in front of you: foes on it are hit and slowed for two seconds.
nusmp.page.book_spatial.blackout: Black matter carries you and up to three allies within five blocks to the point you aim at (20 blocks at most).
nusmp.page.book_spatial.rift_burst: Tears space open at the aimed point: a burst that hurts and throws foes away (the wiki's Spatial Rupture is already a page of the Bone book, so this one has its own name).
nusmp.page.book_spatial.archangel_destru: Five homing spheres of erasing force seek your foes and strip a beneficial effect from each.
nusmp.page.book_spatial.different_dimens: Seals one foe in a sphere of another dimension: held still for a few seconds (shares the control cooldown).
nusmp.page.book_mirror.shard_shot: A shard of mirror glass flies straight and shatters on the first foe it meets.
nusmp.page.book_mirror.glint_flash: A blinding flash off a mirror round you: foes close to you are hurt and blinded for two seconds.
nusmp.page.book_mirror.silver_backing: A silver backing on your skin for eight seconds: damage taken is reduced and attackers are hit back.
nusmp.page.book_mirror.prism_split: A beam is split by a prism into three homing rays.
nusmp.page.book_mirror.large_reflect_ref: Large mirrors bounce magical light between them and destroy what is in the way: a wide, long beam that shoves foes aside.
nusmp.page.book_mirror.hall_of_mirrors: A hall of mirrors at the aimed spot for four seconds: foes inside are hit every half second and slowed as they lose their way.
nusmp.page.book_mirror.mirrors_meteor_dr: A dragon of mirror light runs 22 blocks along your aim and lands as a meteor at its end: everything on the line is hit, foes at the end take half a blow more.
nusmp.page.book_time.stopwatch_strike: Starts a stopwatch on the foe you look at: a quick hit and a second of slowness as its time runs back.
nusmp.page.book_time.borrowed_second: Borrows a second from tomorrow: you heal a little and move faster for three seconds.
nusmp.page.book_time.frozen_instant: Catches the foe you look at in a frozen instant: a hit, then two seconds in which it can hardly move or strike.
nusmp.page.book_time.dial_back: Turns the dial back on everything round you: foes are hit, pushed back where they stood a moment ago and slowed.
nusmp.page.book_time.slow_hour: Five slow hours over the aimed spot: a clock face hangs there and foes inside are dragged slow and hurt every half second.
nusmp.page.book_legion.bishops_reach: The bishop strikes along a long straight line: everything on it is hit.
nusmp.page.book_legion.queens_charge: The queen charges 9 blocks forward, striking and knocking back everything on her path.
nusmp.page.book_legion.checkmate_field: A board of checks at the aimed spot for four seconds: foes inside are hit every half second and kept from running.
nusmp.page.book_key.lock_pick: A thin pick flies straight and springs the lock on the first foe it meets: it takes a hit and loses one beneficial effect.
